leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a mock server using a Node.js framework
Configure mock endpoints to simulate third-party API responses
Implement request handlers for different HTTP methods
Manipulate response data to match expected third-party formats
Integrate the mock server with existing application code
Control server behavior through environment variables
Construct dynamic mock responses based on request parameters
lessonTitle: Build mock server for third party dependencies
